name: Insane Druids
summary: A massacre in Dor'Danil Barrow Den leaves its druids' spirits in torment. Kayneth Stillwind, a night elf sentinel in eastern Ashenvale, learns of the slaughter through a vision while battling Forsaken toxins.

sections.title: A Vision of Slaughter
sections.body: Kayneth Stillwind sees a massacre in a waking vision. The night elf sentinel is battling the effects of Forsaken toxins found in eastern Ashenvale when he witnesses what happened beneath the mounds of Dor'Danil Barrow Den. Undead infiltrators poisoned the druids in their sleep and slaughtered them. Their souls were torn from their bodies by the venom, leaving them as wild, shrieking spirits.

sections.title: Mercy for the Slain Leaders
sections.body: Kayneth Stillwind asks you to quiet the suffering beneath Dor'Danil Barrow Den. The druids' phantoms have been driven mad by the way they died, and cannot find release in the underground chambers. Their circle's three leaders, Taneel Darkwood, Uthil Mooncall, and Mavoris Cloudsbreak, remain among the restless dead. Lay them to rest, and the den may begin to heal from its defilement.

faq.q: Who poisoned the druids in Dor'Danil Barrow Den?
faq.answer: Forsaken infiltrators poisoned and murdered the druids in Dor'Danil Barrow Den. Kayneth Stillwind saw the crime in a vision while suffering from Forsaken toxins gathered from undead agents in Ashenvale.

faq.q: Why did the druids become insane ghosts?
faq.answer: The druids became mad spirits after they were killed in their sleep. The Forsaken's alchemical poisons tore their souls from their bodies in an unnatural, agonizing way.

faq.q: Who are Taneel Darkwood, Uthil Mooncall, and Mavoris Cloudsbreak?
faq.answer: Taneel Darkwood, Uthil Mooncall, and Mavoris Cloudsbreak led the druidic circle in Dor'Danil Barrow Den. Their spirits anchor the den's madness, so they must be laid to rest for the others to find peace.

faq.q: Where is the Dor'Danil Barrow Den located?
faq.answer: Dor'Danil Barrow Den lies underground in southeastern Ashenvale, just south of the ruins of Forest Song.

faq.q: Who gives the quest to put the druids to rest?
faq.answer: Kayneth Stillwind, a night elf at Forest Song in eastern Ashenvale, asks you to help after you assist him in researching Forsaken diseases.

faq.q: Does slaying the leaders purge the den entirely?
faq.answer: Slaying the three leaders eases the spiritual anguish in the barrow den. Kayneth says this is one step toward helping the remaining maddened spirits find peace.

angles.text: As a night elf, you can see the slaughter of sleeping druids in Dor'Danil Barrow Den as an outrage against nature and the Kaldorei. The Forsaken must answer for it.
As a druid, you can grant Taneel Darkwood, Uthil Mooncall, and Mavoris Cloudsbreak a solemn mercy. You free fellow practitioners of the Cenarion arts from alchemical madness.
As an Alliance member, you see the Forsaken's cruelty reach far beyond Lordaeron. Their plagues are carried into distant lands to kill innocents in their sleep.
